snippet.title: Journey of Realm: Dawn Dew is officially launched!
snippet.description:
Greetings, everyone! After countless days and nights of meticulous development, we're thrilled to announce:
Journey of Realm: Dawn Dew officially launches on August 14!
In the full release, you'll:
- Explore 10 unique regions
- Combine 70+ skills in free-form builds
- Challenge 20 powerful bosses
- Discover over 100 hidden items across the realm
... all alongside「Dew」on her grand adventure!

Journey of Realm: Dawn Dew is officially launched!

 #indiegame  #arpg #2d #gaming #gamedevblog
